name: ShardChat
source:
Welcome to ShardChat, the chat program for the popular MMO Shardfall!

You are MacabrePixie, the leader of Asylum, one of the top raiding guilds on your server. Following a rough raid night, one of your guild officers and good friend, Necronomicon,  has asked for a private chat. After a quick AFK, you log into ShardChat to receive his call...

[from [url=https://frozenstar.itch.io/shardchat]itch.io[/url]]
